notes: Twitch on the Watch screen (2026-10-05, 'Twitch I see cases where watch and live would be used, probably not library'): Live = the channels the account follows that are live now (Following > Live), typed by Twitch's category, favorite; Watch = the person's own rows, Followed channels (the side nav, expanded) with their live state, and the latest videos of followed channels (Following > Videos, the list page). No Library, no Browse. Subscriptions are not read: the account's Subscriptions page is an account page. A press on a live channel or a video opens its page, which plays.

verified.videoTags: /directory/following/live article cards: the tag buttons (data-a-target=tag-button) and the category link, keyed by the channel's login from the card's link, read live 2026-10-11.
verified.videoChannelInfo: /<login>/videos read live 2026-10-11: h1 is the name, 'N followers' in the page's text, each article is a broadcast (a[href^=/videos/], h4 title, .tw-media-card-stat length, views and when, the preview image), the picture is the img whose alt is the name. The About page's description is not on this page.
verified.videoEpisodes: 2026-10-12, read hidden on a followed channel: /<login>/videos?filter=archives&sort=time lists past broadcasts as article cards (a[href^='/videos/<id>'], h4 title, .tw-media-card-stat length / views / 'N days ago', preview img); 30 drawn at load, newest first. Listed as one season, 'Past broadcasts', numbered so the newest is last; a broadcast plays by its /videos/ address. On a /videos/<id> page the channel's login is the h1's own link (context.channel); a live page's is the path.
verified.videoPlay: 2026-10-12 ('tried to start a twitch stream but it failed'): a channel that is offline when its page opens (.channel-status-info reads Offline, no live indicator, read hidden on a channel that had just ended) fails the pick at once as '<name> is offline now' through __prismVideoPlayState, instead of the doctor's two timeouts; the pick is carried across the navigation in sessionStorage as Apple TV's is.
verified.css: 2026-10-12 ('Twitch's chrome shows at first when I land on a video'): in the player's fullscreen (the fullscreen element is div.root) Twitch draws its control bar (data-a-target=player-controls, 50 px) and top bar on entry and keeps them while no pointer move reaches the page (the stage shield lets none through); the wall's own stage bar stands in for them, so they are drawn transparent. Ad labels, the ad countdown and the Skip control are outside these elements.

videoPoolWords.name: live on Twitch, and its past videos
videoPoolWords.counted: Every live stream on Twitch tagged {tags}, up to 40, in Twitch's own Recently started order (the most recently started first), and the past videos Twitch's search lists for {tags}, up to 40, each with the date Twitch shows beside it.
videoPoolWords.who: Every streamer on Twitch, not only the ones you follow.
videoPoolWords.decides: The streamer, by tagging the stream. The order is Twitch's stated sort, chosen by Prism from the ones Twitch offers.
videoPoolWords.source: Twitch's tag directory page and its search page's Past videos, read on a hidden page every half hour while Watch is open.
